situation: Going to Lisbon Oct 10 to 17 and need someone to feed my cat. Want to ask my neighbour Tom, we chat in the hallway but aren't close.
reply: Hi Tom, it's Hana from 3B. I'm away 10 to 17 October and wondered if you could feed Miso once a day while I'm gone. It's about ten minutes: food, water and a quick scoop of the litter tray. I'd drop the key and a short list round on the 9th. If that week's no good, no problem at all, I'll book a sitter. I'll bring you back some pastéis de nata either way.
note: With someone you're not close to, naming the exact size of the job is what makes a yes easy.

situation: I want my old boss Greg to intro me to Aisha, who's hiring a data lead at Fernway. Haven't talked to Greg in about 6 months.
reply: Hi Greg, I'm applying for the data lead role at Fernway, and I saw you're connected with Aisha Rahman, who's hiring for it. Would you be comfortable sending her a short intro? I've written three lines you could forward as is or edit, so it should take five minutes. If you don't know her well enough to vouch, just say so and I'll apply the usual way. Thanks either way, and I hope the new team is treating you well.
note: Doing the drafting for them shrinks the cost; the out covers the real reason people hesitate on intros.

situation: Preciso pedir pro meu amigo Rafa, que tem carro grande, pra me ajudar a levar um sofá de Pinheiros até a Mooca no sábado.
reply: Rafa, pedido sincero: você toparia me ajudar a levar um sofá de Pinheiros até a Mooca no sábado de manhã? Umas duas horas contando o trânsito, e precisa da sua Spin porque o sofá não cabe em carro normal. Se não der, de boa, eu chamo um frete. O almoço é por minha conta de qualquer jeito.
note: The cost (two hours, his car) is stated up front so he isn't agreeing to something bigger than he thought.

situation: 我在申请荷兰代尔夫特理工的硕士，想请本科毕业论文的指导老师王老师写推荐信。毕业三年了，平时联系不多，截止日期是12月1号。
reply: 王老师您好，我是2023届的林悦，毕业论文是您指导的，做的是城市绿地和热岛效应。我现在在申请代尔夫特理工的城市规划硕士，需要一封推荐信，您是最了解我研究能力的老师，所以第一个想到您。大概需要您花一个小时，截止日期是12月1日，您同意的话，我这周就把简历、个人陈述和论文摘要整理好发给您。如果这段时间实在排不开，完全理解，麻烦告诉我一声，我好另外安排。无论如何都谢谢您！
note: 大一点的请求要说清为什么找他、要花多少时间、截止日期，并给一个真正的退路。

situation: I start a new job on Monday but my first paycheck doesn't arrive until October 30, and rent ($1,650) is due Thursday. I want to ask my older sister Mei to lend me $2,000. I've never borrowed from her before.
reply: Hi Mei, bit of an awkward ask, so I'll just say it. My new job starts Monday but the first paycheck doesn't land until 30 October, and rent is due on Thursday. Could you lend me $2,000 to cover rent and groceries until then? I'd pay it all back on 31 October and set up the transfer that day so you never have to chase me. Totally fine to say no if it's a stretch right now.
note: Money from family: exact amount, exact repayment date, and an out that doesn't need a reason.

situation: 上周五在微信上问同事小陈，10月8号周四我出差，能不能帮我代开一下客户周会，他一直没回。周会前我还得交接材料。
reply: 小陈，上周问你10月8号周四帮我代开客户周会的事，你那边不方便的话完全没关系，麻烦周五前跟我说一声就行，我好去问问其他人。能帮的话，我周五下班前把议程和客户背景发你，大概半小时就能看完。
note: 没回复时跟进一次，重申退路，给一个明确的回复时间；如果还是没回，就当作不行，换人问。

situation: My friend Marcus said he'd help me move tomorrow morning with his truck. He just texted that he can't make it, his daughter Ellie has a fever. I'm stressed and a bit annoyed but I don't want to guilt-trip him.
reply: Oh no, hope Ellie's fever breaks soon. No problem at all, I'll book a van for the morning. Give her a hug from me.
note: When a yes turns into a late no, absorb it in one line. No guilt trip keeps the door open for the next favour, in either direction.

situation: I have a job interview in Chicago on Wednesday Oct 14 and hotels are $250 a night. My college friend Amara lives there, we haven't seen each other in a year. Want to ask if I can crash on her couch Tuesday and Wednesday nights.
reply: Hi Amara! I've got an interview in Chicago on Wednesday 14 October, and I wondered if I could crash on your couch the Tuesday and Wednesday nights, 13 and 14. I'd be out most of Wednesday and heading to the airport Thursday morning, so I'd barely be in your way. Totally fine if it's a bad week, I'll book a hotel, no problem. Either way, dinner's on me Wednesday night, I'd love to catch up.
note: Name the exact nights and how little space you'll take, give a real out, and offer something you'd genuinely want to do anyway.

situation: My friend Dana is a commercial property lawyer. I'm about to sign a 3-year lease for my bakery and want her to look it over before Friday Oct 9. I don't want to take advantage of her just because we're friends.
reply: Hi Dana, you're the only lawyer I know who does commercial leases, so I'm going to ask: would you have 30 minutes before Friday Oct 9 to skim the 4-page lease for the bakery and flag anything that would worry you? Not a full review, just 'I'd push back on this clause'. If you'd rather keep work and friends separate, or you'd want to bill it as a normal job, say so, both are completely fine. Dinner at Osteria Nove is on me either way.
note: When the favour is someone's profession, keep the scope narrow and make paying or declining as easy as saying yes.

situation: 我在火锅店做服务员，10月10号周六是我的晚班，那天我表妹订婚，想去。想问同事小敏能不能跟我换班，她下周二10月13号是早班，我可以替她上。
reply: 小敏，想请你帮个忙：10月10号周六的晚班你能跟我换吗？那天我表妹订婚。你13号周二的早班我来上，你那天能睡个懒觉。周六晚上人多挺累的，不方便就直说，我再问问别人。周四前告诉我就行。
note: 换班请求把日期、代价（周六晚班累）和回报一次说清，再给一个真的出口和答复期限。

situation: I'm on night shifts at the hospital from Oct 12 to Oct 30, so I can't do the 5pm Tuesday and Thursday run to football practice for my son Eli (9). Want to ask the other parents in the team WhatsApp group if anyone can take him.
reply: Hi all, a practical ask: I'm on night shifts from 12 to 30 October, so I can't do the 5pm run to Tuesday and Thursday practice for Eli. Could anyone with a spare seat pick him up from the Ashgrove Primary gate at 4:45 on one of those days? It's six sessions in total, so even one or two would help a lot. No worries if the timing doesn't work, I'll book the after-school club otherwise. Once I'm back on days I'm happy to take a carful on Saturdays.
note: In a group ask, split the favour into small pieces so people can offer one slot without signing up for all six.

situation: I manage a team of six. We need two people to help staff our stand at a home show on Saturday Oct 17, 9am to 3pm. It's not in anyone's contract and I want it to be genuinely optional, not the kind of 'volunteer' everyone knows is mandatory.
reply: Hi team, a genuinely optional ask: I need two people to help me run our stand at the Leeds Home Show on Saturday 17 October, 9am to 3pm. It's mostly chatting to visitors and handing out brochures, on your feet most of the day, with travel paid. Anyone who does it gets a full day off in lieu, on a date of their choosing. If nobody fancies it, that's completely fine, it won't come up at review time and I'll book temp staff instead. Message me privately by Friday 9 October if you're up for it.
note: When you have power over the person, the out has to be explicit, and private replies mean nobody feels watched saying no.

situation: I'm an ICU nurse thinking about moving into UX research. I found Jordan Lee on LinkedIn, a UX researcher at a health-tech company who used to be a nurse too. We've never met. I want to ask for a short call.
reply: Hi Jordan, I'm an ICU nurse in Leeds looking at a move into UX research, and your path from nursing into research at Carewell is the closest match to mine I've found. Would you be open to a 20-minute video call sometime in the next few weeks? I have three specific questions, mostly about how you landed your first research role, and I'll fit around your schedule. If you're too busy, no problem at all, and thanks for reading this either way.
note: A stranger owes you nothing: say why them, cap the time, and make ignoring the message painless.
